subject: E-Commerce
title: Africa's Mobile Commerce Leap
description: One-minute skill: Africa's Mobile Commerce Leap.

hook.text: Kenya's M-Pesa processes more transactions per capita than PayPal. It started with simple SMS texts.

buildup.text: Most Africans didn't have bank accounts or internet in 2007. But they had feature phones with SMS.

discovery.text: M-Pesa let users send money via text message. No smartphone, no bank account, no internet required.

twist.text: Jumia, 'Africa's Amazon,' went public in 2019 but struggled. Logistics across 54 countries is brutally hard.

climax.text: Africa is building e-commerce on mobile-first payments, skipping desktop and credit cards entirely.

punchline.text: No banks, no internet, no problem. SMS payments built African e-commerce.

quiz.question: How does M-Pesa enable commerce without banks?
options: SMS-based money transfers on feature phones
